question.text: Mr. Suresh Menon, an HNI LP in 'Krishna Cat II AIF' (committed INR 5 crore), wishes to transfer his commitment to his adult son mid-fund. Considering the AIF's onboarding and transfer controls, the Manager's MOST appropriate action is to:

answer.text: Refuse all transfers categorically regardless of the contribution agreement terms
Permit the transfer subject to completion of KYC on the transferee and to the terms of the fund's contribution agreement, while ensuring continued compliance with the INR 1 crore minimum investment
Automatically cancel Mr. Menon's entire commitment

explanation.text: The Logic: An RTA handles transfer of AIF units, and KYC applies at onboarding and on an ongoing basis. Transfers and exits are subject to KYC and to the terms of the fund's contribution agreement, while the INR 1 crore minimum investor commitment must continue to be respected. The Trap: Option A ignores the contribution agreement and the workbook-supported transfer/exit mechanic. Option C fails KYC requirements. Option D penalises the LP beyond what the agreement and regulations permit. Note: The two non-negotiable checks on any transfer are (i) KYC on the incoming investor and (ii) the minimum investor commitment threshold.
